items.question: Has the team asked management for a going concern assessment covering at least twelve months from the date of the financial statements, and obtained it?
Has the team looked for warning signs: losses, negative cash flow, net current liabilities, loan defaults, lost customers or licences, litigation or unpaid statutory dues?
Has the forecast or cash flow of management been obtained, and are its assumptions reasonable and supported?
Has the team checked the support from owners, banks or lenders where the entity relies on it, and obtained written confirmation where needed?
Has the team considered events after the year-end that bear on the ability of the entity to continue?
Has the team concluded whether a material uncertainty exists, and is the disclosure in the financial statements adequate?
Has the effect on the audit report been decided (no change, emphasis of matter or material uncertainty paragraph, or modified opinion)?
